notes.title: Welcome to my game!
notes.content:
Hello, guys!

I'm fullstack fulltime developer on the factory at the day and solo indie developer at the night ^_^ And the last 5 months I was working on the new free project - Christmas Tree Clicker.

In this game I want to mix an Gacha + Clicker + Collection Card Game mechanics with a Christmas holidays mood.

Nowadays I made a small early Demo, that demonstrate a base game loop without Toys Collection and now I'm working on the real core loop with all mechanics.

I plan to make a game with:
- Collection of 34 random toys with individual boosts from gifts (first screenshot, all art is ready right now)
- Collection of Decoration for your holidays Desktop (second screenshot)
- Santa character with fun tutorial, animations and dialogs with player =)
- Christmas Tree decoration by Toys and Desktop decoration by Decor
- Good math Clicker progress with counter under the Gift Bag
- Offline reward
- Union boosts by Drag&Drop
- Start with Windows option (yes, this game only for Windows users)
- Steam achievements
- Steam trading cards, if this project will be very interesting for the community
- Text localization for the most popular languages

I'm making this project on the QT 5 framework and I can talking about development at the devlogs, if I will see your activity in comments.

Repeat, this is will be a free project with DLC and I hope, that experience of my game will be happy for as much people at that can!

Good Luck and Best Regards,
Evgeniy Psarev
